hook.name: BaldpadFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Baldpad protocol that charges directional quote-currency fees on swaps, splitting revenue between a per-pool creator and a platform treasury. Supports a configurable opening fee that linearly decays to a base rate over a set time window, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta.
